topic: The planet where it rains glass
script: On a planet called HD 189733 b, it may rain glass. It is a giant gas planet about 64 light-years away. Its winds may blow at thousands of kilometers per hour. So the glass would fly sideways instead of falling. From far away, the planet looks a deep cobalt blue. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
title: It Rains Glass Sideways on This Planet #Exoplanet #SpaceFacts #Shorts
description:
HD 189733 b, a blue gas giant 64 light-years away, may have silicate glass rain driven sideways by winds of thousands of km/h.
